smtp_send Example

Send mail over implicit TLS or STARTTLS.

Contents

Building and Running
Source

Building and Running

examples/tls/smtp_send.cpp, one source file built by examples/CMakeLists.txt as smtp_send (cmake-build/examples/smtp_send on Linux, cmake-build\examples\Release\smtp_send.exe on Windows) and run by tests/run_tests.sh. See Building and Running for the build commands. The comment at the top of the file describes the program. Back to the example programs.

Send a plain text email over TLS. The message body is read from
standard input. Implicit TLS is used unless --starttls is given.

Usage: smtp_send host port user password from to subject
       [--starttls] [--ca ca.pem] [--insecure]
Use - for user to skip the login.
*/
// ----------------------------------------------------------- // 
#include "gxdlcode.h"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include "gxsmtp.h"
#include "common_opts.h"

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
  TLSOptions opt;
  opt.Parse(argc, argv);
  if(opt.args.size() < 7) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << argv[0] << " host port user password from to "
              << "subject [--starttls] [--ca ca.pem] [--insecure]\n";
    return 1;
  }
  const std::vector<std::string> &a = opt.args;
  std::string body((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(std::cin)),
                   std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());

  gxsSMTPClient smtp;
  opt.Apply(smtp);
  if(smtp.Connect(a[0], std::atoi(a[1].c_str()), 
                  opt.starttls ? gxsMAIL_STARTTLS : gxsMAIL_IMPLICIT_TLS) != 0) {
    std::cerr << smtp.Error() << "\n";
    return 1;
  }
  if(a[2] != "-" && smtp.Login(a[2], a[3]) != 0) {
    std::cerr << smtp.Error() << "\n";
    return 1;
  }
  if(smtp.SendMessage(a[4], { a[5] }, a[6], body) != 0) {
    std::cerr << smtp.Error() << "\n";
    return 1;
  }
  smtp.Quit();
  std::cout << "Message sent" << "\n";
  return 0;
}
